messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problem calculating ranking in dplyr
parts:
Hi,
 I am after calculating league position for soccer tables

example data for a teamSeason table is 

       TEAMNAME    season totPoints totGF totGA totGD pos
1       Arsenal        1992/1993        56    40    38        2     1
2      Aston Villa   1992/1993         74    57    40      17   1
3      Blackburn   1992/1993          71    68    46      22   1


I have calculated the pos as 

tbl_df(teamSeason) %>%
  group_by(TEAMNAME,season) %>%
  mutate(pos=row_number(totPoints)) 

but all the pos values are 1

The actual calculation of pos that I want is desc(totPoints),desc(totGD),desc(totGF),TEAMNAME

TIA

messages.author: f8f346cc57e6f097
messages.subject: Re: Problem calculating ranking in dplyr
parts:
It seems to me that you would want to be grouping by season only — not TEAMNAME AND season, as this will uniquely identify each row (and hence position will always be one!).
